name: AC - Quiz Nightly Data Sync (MySQL → Mautic)

parameters.query:
SELECT
  c.id AS contact_id,
  c.email AS contact_email,
  c.first_name AS contact_first_name,
  c.last_name AS contact_last_name,
  u.id AS coach_user_id,
  u.first_name AS coach_first_name,
  u.last_name AS coach_last_name,
  u.full_name AS coach_full_name,
  u.email AS coach_email,
  u.phone_number AS coach_phone,
  u.area_code AS coach_phone_prefix,
  u.sub_domain AS coach_slug,
  o.org_name AS coach_organisation_name
FROM prod_contacts_activesupport.contacts c
LEFT JOIN prod_activesupport.users u ON u.id = c.coach_id
LEFT JOIN prod_activesupport.organizations o ON o.id = u.organization_id
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND (
    c.updated_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY
    OR u.updated_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY
  )
LIMIT 500
